critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 827 lines - splitting into routers (auth, customers, caretakers, fertilizer, cocoa_records, rate, dashboard) is overdue per the file-size guideline.

Caretaker money/records endpoints are addressed by ARRAY INDEX (POST /customers/{id}/caretakers/{index}/debts). This works with the current UI but is fragile: if two admins concurrently add/remove caretakers, indices shift and one client can mutate the wrong caretaker. Consider addressing caretakers by their `id` field (already generated) instead of positional index.
update_customer merges caretakers by NAME (existing = {ct.name: ct}) which will collide/lose data if two caretakers share a name. Prefer matching by id.

Fertilizer 'return' endpoint (PATCH .../fertilizer/{fid}/return) is still exposed even though UI removed it - dead-ish surface. Fine for backward compat but document intent or remove in a future clean-up.
